At a glance

A compact wall-mounted DC charger from Spain: 20 kW with a 5 m CCS2 cable. For places where cars stay a while but still need DC speed.

  • 4G: the charger stays online without Wi-Fi wherever there is mobile signal.
  • Made in Spain.

In the box and installation

In the box

DC charger with cables, wall bracket, manual in Serbian.

What installation needs

A DC charger needs a three-phase supply of matching capacity. The site owner files the grid connection request; we provide the charger’s technical data. Installation and commissioning are agreed in the quote.
